title: Illuminated n-type bar with one contact: minority-hole diffusion length, SRH + radiative lifetime (analytic)
description:
An n-type bar (N_D = 1e23 1/m^3, n_i 1e16, 10 um long, two 5 nm cells high) with a single ohmic contact on [0, 20 nm] (0 V) and uniform generation G = 1e27 1/(m^3 s) (generation feature on all; contact cells generate nothing), SRH lifetime tau_srh plus radiative B = 1e-16 m^3/s (B N_D = 1e7 1/s). With one contact the total current is zero: the electron and hole contact currents separate the minority diffusion current. Stationary sweep tau_srh = 1e-10..3e-8 s (diffusion length 0.35..5.4 um). Low injection (excess holes <= 2.3e19 = 2.3e-4 N_D).
Analytic: tau_eff = 1 / (1 / tau_srh + B N_D), L = sqrt(D_p tau_eff), D_p = mu_p V_T; the excess holes vanish at the innermost contact cell centre x_c = w_contact - dx / 2 and are insulated at Lx: dp = G tau_eff (1 - cosh((Lx - x) / L) / cosh(W / L)), W = Lx - x_c. Hole current into the contact I_h = q G Ly (L tanh(W / L) - dx / 2) per m of depth (the half cell between x_c and the contact edge belongs to the contact and generates nothing); the free cells recombine the rest, integral R = G Ly (W - L tanh(W / L)).
Derived values tab: I_electron (contact electron_current, = +I_h), I_hole (-hole_current, = I_h: the total is zero), L_measured = I_electron / (q G Ly) + dx / 2 against L tanh(W / L), R_total (integral of semiconductor_recombination) and P_max (largest hole density, at the cell next to x = Lx). Expect ~1e-4 (low-injection and ambipolar corrections ~dp / N_D, discretisation ~(dx / L)^2 / 24).
Sweep tab: the five derived values versus tau_srh (log axis useful) with their dashed curves: L_measured grows as sqrt(tau_eff) and bends over at tanh(W / L) and at the radiative limit tau_eff -> 1e-7 s.
Line profile tab (last sweep value, 3e-8 s): P_profile, the cosh profile from p0 at the contact to its maximum at Lx. Field tab: N, P, recombination, V.

parameters.name: tau_srh
parameters.description: SRH lifetime of both carriers in s (the sweep runs 1e-10..3e-8 s)

parameters.name: T_lat
parameters.description: lattice temperature in K (the semiconductor temperature setting)

parameters.name: w_contact
parameters.description: width of the ohmic contact at x_lo

parameters.name: x_c
parameters.description: centre of the innermost held contact cell (excess holes 0 there)

parameters.name: W_free
parameters.description: diffusion width from x_c to the insulated end in m

parameters.name: tau_eff
parameters.description: low-injection hole lifetime (SRH + radiative) in s

parameters.name: L_tanh
parameters.description: effective collection length L tanh(W / L) in m

parameters.name: I_h_ref
parameters.description: analytic hole current into the contact in A/m

parameters.name: R_total_ref
parameters.description: analytic recombination per m of depth in 1/(m s)

parameters.name: P_max_ref
parameters.description: hole density at the last cell centre Lx - dx / 2 in 1/m^3
